meta.name: Morning TIL — multi-agent pipeline
meta.oneLiner: Every morning, a LangGraph pipeline generates fun-fact/TIL content. Ollama 7B workers do web research; DeepSeek orchestrates — plans topics, dispatches workers, ranks/edits drafts, assembles the digest.
meta.note: This app only TRACKS the project. The project itself lives in its own repo.

cards.title: Create repo + Python env (uv/venv), pin deps
Install Ollama, pull a 7B model (qwen2.5:7b / mistral:7b), verify local inference
Get DeepSeek API key, hello-world chat call, note pricing
LangGraph hello-world: 2-node graph with state
Pick + wire search tool (Tavily free tier / DuckDuckGo / SearxNG)
Single worker agent: topic in → search → summarized TIL out
Prompt-tune worker for TIL tone (surprising, source-cited, 3-5 sentences)
Orchestrator node: DeepSeek plans N topics for the day
Fan-out: parallel Ollama workers research + draft (LangGraph Send API)
DeepSeek ranks drafts, sends weak ones back with steering notes
Digest assembler: final markdown digest with sources
SQLite history store + dedupe new TILs against past topics (embeddings or keyword)
Fact-check pass: second search to verify each claim
Interestingness scoring rubric (novelty, surprise, credibility)
Morning schedule: cron (macOS launchd) job at 7am
Delivery: Telegram bot (or email / markdown file to Obsidian)
LangSmith tracing on all runs
Token + cost log per run (DeepSeek $ vs local $0)
Graceful failures: Ollama down → skip worker; search rate-limited → backoff + retry
Retries with jitter on all external calls

architectureNotes:
## Architecture (draft — edit me)

```
            ┌─────────────────────────────┐
            │  DeepSeek (orchestrator)    │
            │  plan topics → dispatch →   │
            │  rank/steer → assemble      │
            └──────┬─────────────┬────────┘
         Send API  │             │  rank / rewrite loop
     ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐
     ▼             ▼             ▼
 ┌────────┐   ┌────────┐   ┌────────┐
 │worker 1│   │worker 2│   │worker N│   (Ollama 7B, parallel)
 │search+ │   │search+ │   │search+ │
 │draft   │   │draft   │   │draft   │
 └───┬────┘   └───┬────┘   └───┬────┘
     └───────────┬┴────────────┘
                 ▼
          SQLite history (dedupe)
                 ▼
          Morning digest → Telegram/email/markdown
```

**State shape:** topics[], drafts[], rankings[], final_digest

**Key decisions to make:** worker model choice, search tool, dedupe strategy (embeddings vs keywords), rewrite loop depth (cap at 1-2 to bound cost/latency).

decisionLog.decision: Frontier model (DeepSeek) steers, local 7B models do grunt work
decisionLog.why: Cost: research/drafting is high-token, low-difficulty — local is free. Planning/ranking is low-token, high-difficulty — worth API spend. Also a great interview talking point about model routing.
Checkpointing, retries, and the Send API for fan-out come free; graph is self-documenting for the demo; LangGraph experience is directly interview-relevant.
